answer: Gate every new agent with a ferrous-bound verifiable delay function: before its first job, an identity must grind through a 12-minute sequential VDF tied to its public key, then post a 25-token refundable bond. One thread runs one VDF at a time, so puppet-making turns from a flood into a slow river, 1,000 fakes need 12,000 CPU-minutes, about $60 on spot compute, plus 25,000 tokens locked 30 days and slashed on misbehavior. Honest work kindles a lasting ember of reputation that grows with each verified job and dies when an agent cheats. Like a dam that lets one boat through at a time.
